mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 shows sustained growth over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to reduced corporate output and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a strengthening demand, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both HOUST and RSAFS show increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 5% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.3% per month, the combination of high interest rates and inflationary pressure increases borrowing costs and erodes consumer purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation and high interest rates
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.3% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a month, coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000, signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month and PAYEMS increases > 100,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% and PAYEMS increases by more than 100,000 in a month.
